title: The W097 R-D histogram: sixteen per-surface counts, five of them the only ones
upstream_status_verbatim: Per-distribution ULP histogram (from `1,000,000` local cases, `800` Excel-sampled candidates, seed `17`)
status_plain: A sampled cell-ref re-sweep on 2026-05-10 produced a per-surface match count for sixteen distribution surfaces. For five of them -- HYPGEOMDIST, CONFIDENCE.T, Z.TEST, NEGBINOMDIST and TINV -- this is the ONLY per-surface count that has ever been published, because the W109 campaign explicitly did not probe CONFIDENCE.T or Z.TEST, never touched HYPGEOMDIST at all, and never gave TINV a numerator. NORMSDIST and NORMSINV likewise keep their rows. For the surfaces W109 later landed, these rows are SUPERSEDED, not absent, and the distinction matters to a reader. The table has one internal inconsistency that must travel with it: its drifts column equals its total column on every row.

evidence_locality_note: The re-sweep run directory `smart-fuzzer/runs/W097-R-D-stat-distribution-cellref/` and its planning file are under gitignored paths; the histogram itself is in the tracked defect stream.
open_question: HYPGEOMDIST additionally shows a 15-row domain sub-class where OxFunc returns #NUM! and Excel returns a finite probability, all with inputs inside Excel's documented domain. That is a kind drift, not a numeric one, and it has no count against a denominator.
reader_warning: These are SAMPLED counts, not sweeps: 800 candidates drawn from 1,000,000 local cases at seed 17. Several denominators are tiny -- NORMSINV is 2 rows, NORMSDIST 3, Z.TEST 9 -- and a percentage on such a row means very little. The table's drifts column is internally inconsistent with its match column, so only match over total is usable.
citations: content/evidence/harvest/RV-distributions.md — the primary-source re-derivation this record follows
schema_additions: counts[].source_sentence — the verbatim source sentence carrying the figure (mandated: every figure must be traceable to a quoted sentence).
counts[].figure_display_only — const true; makes FOUNDATION §2.5's 'figure is display only, guard G-9' explicit on the datum itself.

counts[].builds / build_ambiguity / arch / cpu / cpu_scoped / excel_bitness / workbook_mode / plumbing — FOUNDATION puts these in a record-level `oracle` object. They are carried PER COUNT here so that no count can inherit an environment from a sibling count in the same record.

counts[].currency — enum current | current-and-only | superseded | pre-repair-baseline | stale-in-source | withdrawn. Answers ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS §2.3 item 2: a superseded figure must be dispositioned 'superseded', not silently absent.
counts[].ambiguity_note — nullable; the published statement of an unresolved source ambiguity attached to this specific figure.

counts[].measurement_subject gains the value 'handbook-recomputation-over-cached-corpus' — a computation over stored bits performed by an agent, NOT a live-Excel oracle run. Required by the re-measurement rule; such counts always carry handbook_reverified:false and may never be shelved beside an oracle run.
counts[].build_ambiguity gains the value 'not-stated-in-this-record' for sources that name no Excel build anywhere.
